svg.title: Interactive list — what I build
svg.desc: An animated slideshow that cycles through six sections: Systems that think. — AI Systems Architect and CS student in Bengaluru, building agentic software with a human in the loop.; ARES-X Titan — A sovereign AI intelligence OS: C4ISR-inspired, red-team aware, with human approval gates.; Voice, in 3D — Real-time voice AI with a three-dimensional interface you can talk to.; Quiet Automation — End-to-end workflows on n8n, Zapier, webhooks and REST. The boring work, handled.; Reading the Market — A NIFTY futures research tool for the Indian market.; Let's work together. — Open to freelance, automation and technical writing. Say hello on LinkedIn.
